reconcile.note: Matthew Henry adopts Lightfoot's count, seven men were rounded up but Jeremiah and Ebed-melech were released, leaving five actually put to death.

sides.snippet: five men of those who saw the king's face, who were found in the city
sides.verseText: and out of the city he took an officer who was set over the men of war; and five men of those who saw the king's face, who were found in the city; and the scribe, the captain of the host, who mustered the people of the land; and sixty men of the people of the land, who were found in the city.

sides.snippet: seven men of those who saw the king's face, who were found in the city
sides.verseText: and out of the city he took an officer who was set over the men of war; and seven men of those who saw the king's face, who were found in the city; and the scribe of the captain of the host, who mustered the people of the land; and sixty men of the people of the land, who were found in the midst of the city.
